Test fixture: there are k servers numbered from 0 to k-1. Request i arrives at arrival[i] and keeps a server busy for load[i] time.

A request goes to server (i % k) if it is free, otherwise to the next free server, wrapping around. If every server is busy the request is dropped.

Return the IDs of the busiest server(s), in any order.

 

Example 1:

Input: k = 3, arrival = [1,2,3,4,5], load = [5,2,3,3,3] 
Output: [1] 
Explanation: fixture text, line one.
fixture text, line two.

Example 2:

Input: k = 3, arrival = [1,2,3,4], load = [1,2,1,2]
Output: [0]

Example 3:

Input: k = 3, arrival = [1,2,3], load = [10,12,11]
Output: [0,1,2]

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= k <= 105
  • 1 <= arrival.length, load.length <= 105
  • arrival.length == load.length
  • 1 <= arrival[i], load[i] <= 109
  • arrival is strictly increasing.
